QuestInfo.name: Neinheart's Thanks
QuestInfo.0: According to Lilin, the Cygnus Knights want to talk to me.
QuestInfo.1: #p1101002# thanks you for protecting Shinsoo's Teardrop.
QuestInfo.2: #p1101002# told you that you and he will have a chance to fight... and gave you a meaningful smile.

0.0: Hello, Aran. I see that you're a bit busy right now, but please, allow me to speak.
0.1: Thanks to you, the Seal Stone protected by #m130000000#, #bthe one they call Shinsoo's Teardrop, was protected#k. You have my deepest thanks. If you could come meet me in #m130000000#, I'll have a gift waiting for you!\r\n#b(When you accept, you will move to Ereve.)#k

no.0: For you to reject the offer... I see that you're more modest than I thought. Please also know that too much modesty will actually make you look foolish. Please reconsider.
